title: GST Registration
description: Bidder must have a valid GST registration certificate (GSTIN) issued by the Government of India.

title: PAN Card
description: Bidder must have a valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by Income Tax Department.

title: Udyam / MSME Registration
description: Preference given to bidders with valid Udyam Registration Certificate (MSME). Provides eligibility for MSME benefits.

title: Minimum Average Annual Turnover
description: Bidder must demonstrate an average annual turnover of at least ₹10 Crore over the last 3 financial years.

title: Minimum Relevant Experience
description: Bidder must have at least 5 years of relevant experience in supply and installation of IoT or industrial automation equipment.

title: ISO 9001:2015 Certification
description: Bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System certification from an accredited certification body.

title: EPFO Registration
description: Bidder must be registered with Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) as per EPF and MP Act, 1952.

title: ESIC Registration
description: Bidder must be registered with Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) as per ESI Act, 1948.

title: OEM Authorization
description: Bidder must provide valid OEM authorization letter from the original equipment manufacturer for the IoT monitoring equipment being supplied.

title: Make in India Declaration
description: Bidder must submit a declaration confirming that the equipment meets Make in India guidelines as per Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017.

title: Non-Blacklisting Declaration
description: Bidder must submit a self-declaration that it has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Central/State Government or PSU.

title: Minimum Completed Similar Projects
description: Bidder must have completed at least 3 similar projects (IoT/industrial automation) of value ≥ ₹1 Crore each in the last 5 years.

title: Solvency Certificate
description: Bidder must provide a Solvency Certificate from a scheduled bank certifying that the company is financially solvent.

title: BIS / CE Certification for Equipment
description: The IoT monitoring equipment must carry BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) or CE marking certification for electrical safety compliance.

title: IT Security Compliance (ISO 27001)
description: Preferred: Bidder or their IoT platform should have ISO 27001 Information Security Management certification.

title: Technical Manpower
description: Bidder must have at least 20 qualified technical personnel with relevant experience in IoT system installation and maintenance.

title: Registered Office in India
description: Bidder must have a registered office address in India with valid incorporation certificate.

title: Annual Maintenance Contract Capability
description: Bidder should have demonstrated AMC/support capability with previous clients for at least 2 years post-delivery.

title: Bid Security (EMD)
description: Bidder must submit Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of ₹24 Lakhs (0.5% of estimated value) via DD or Bank Guarantee.

title: NABL Accredited Testing Report
description: Equipment performance testing report from NABL accredited laboratory is preferred for additional technical compliance.
